_README: This is the ONLY file you need to edit. url + email, feeds (jobs + results/admit-cards), caps per run. The automation runs 6x/day; data/last-run.json shows how the last run went.
_adsNote: Ads: adsenseId = your AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-…), adsenseSlot = optional in-article ad unit ID. admob = the Android app's AdMob IDs (appId ca-app-pub-…~…, banner/inline/interstitial/rewarded/native ca-app-pub-…/…); a change here rebuilds the app. appAds = app ad switches, applied to installed apps within minutes (rewarded = the opt-in 'watch a video, no ads for rewardHours hours' offer; native = one ad card in each list; pro = offer the one-time Pro purchase, product id proProduct, once it exists in Play Console). playUrl = the Play Store listing URL once live (the /app/ page and share links point there).

admob._mediationNote: Ad networks built into the app for AdMob mediation/bidding. Also available: pangle, pubmatic, bigo, chartboost. Remove any you don't sign up for (each adds app size). Turn each on in AdMob > Mediation.

_feedsNote: Dead feeds removed 2026-10-15 (govtjobsblog, govtjobsdiary, sarkarifeed, gulfwalkin, gccwalkins). data/last-run.json shows per-feed health each run.

payRates._note: Single source for all salary/tax tools. Update daPercent when the government notifies a new DA (63% from 1 July 2026: Cabinet approval, PIB 28 Oct 2026).
payRates.daNextExpected: Next revision due from 1 January 2027 (not yet announced)
